summary: Dorian LPG Ltd. filed an 8-K announcing a VLGC newbuilding contract with HD Hyundai for one 90,000 cbm vessel at ~$115M (delivery July 2029) and memorandums of agreement to sell three VLGCs (2014-built Corsair and two 2015-built) for aggregate ~$256M, expected delivery to purchasers by Q4 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. Disclosures note no guarantee of completion. This is a routine capital expenditure and fleet renewal update, not a transformative special situation; the sales are not controlling divestitures. Watch for execution risk on vessel deliveries and charter rate estimates.
